## Teaching Experience

### Head Teaching Assistant — Managerial Statistics

**Queen's University, Smith School of Business**

As Head Teaching Assistant for COMM 162 (Managerial Statistics), I supported 600+ undergraduate students in developing their understanding of statistical methods and their application to managerial decision-making.

My responsibilities included coordinating a team of seven teaching assistants, formulating and leading tutorials and exam review sessions, and hosting personalized office hours.
